Implemented the dependency-free Node.js CLI at [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js).

It supports `inspect`, `render`, `inspect_gedzip`, and `render_gedzip`, validates GEDCOM structure/errors, normalizes `CONT` payloads, and reads/writes UTF-8 GEDZIP archives with attachments.

Verified syntax plus GEDCOM and GEDZIP round-trips under Node 22.
